description: This Java class is an implementation of a service that manages loan accrual processing within a microfinance or banking system. It provides methods for adding periodic accruals, reprocessing existing accruals, handling accruals during interest recalculations, loan closure, and foreclosure scenarios. The class coordinates with repositories, scheduling executors, and event notification services to perform complex financial transaction management, including accruals, adjustments, and income postings.

classes.name: LoanAccrualsProcessingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service that manages the processing of loan accrual-related transactions including adding, reprocessing, and handling accruals during different loan lifecycle events.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccruals
methods.description: Adds periodic accrual transactions for all eligible loans up to a given date.

methods.name: addAccruals
methods.description: Performs batch addition of accrual transactions for loans up to a specified date, potentially in parallel.

methods.name: reprocessExistingAccruals
methods.description: Recalculates and reconsolidates accruals for a loan, reversing and creating new accrual transactions as needed.

methods.name: processAccrualsOnInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Handles accrual processing when interest is recalculated on a loan.

methods.name: addIncomePostingAndAccruals
methods.description: Adds income posting and accrual transactions for a specific loan.

methods.name: processIncomePostingAndAccruals
methods.description: Performs income posting and accrual processes as part of interest compounding or recalculation.

methods.name: processAccrualsOnLoanClosure
methods.description: Handles accrual accounting on loan closure, posting final interest, fees, penalties, and income.

methods.name: processAccrualsOnLoanForeClosure
methods.description: Handles accrual adjustments on loan foreclosure, including reversing prior accruals and creating final accrual transactions.
